reviewContext.userProblem: The desktop left pane has no page overview. Users need a collapsible Pages list with numbers, hidden markers, current-page highlight and the tab menu actions.
requiredOutcomes: A collapsible 'Pages (N)' section in the left SidePane between ShapePalette and Layers. Its fold state persists as the pagesListOpen preference and is never stored in the document.
Rows show the 1-based number, the name and a hidden-in-presentation marker. The current row is highlighted and revealed on any page change.
Click, Enter and Space activate a row. Up/Down/Home/End move focus. F2 and double-click rename through pageRenameDraft.
A '...' button and context menu reuse page-actions.ts, extracted from PageTabs.tsx with identical behavior. A '+' button adds a page. Read-only hides editing actions.
DOM interaction tests cover all 8 design scenarios. docs/editing.md documents the Pages list.
constraints: Add no core Command kind and no IR/JSONL field.
PageTabs behavior and the active-tab reveal stay unchanged.
gitPush is false and the output uses no emojis.
nonGoals: Changes to the global test preload or mise.toml

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Extract page-actions.ts from PageTabs.tsx with identical behavior; an axis option changes only the move labels.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Tabs and list cannot drift, and the intake forbids duplicating tab-menu logic (design section 2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Use details/summary with the .nodetto-navigation-group style, as the Layers Comments section does.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: It matches the existing collapsible style and gives native expanded state to assistive tech (design section 4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Skip drag-to-reorder and offer Move up/Move down through editor.reorderPage.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: pageTabDropAt hit-tests a horizontal strip only, and the intake allowed drag only if PageTabDrag could be reused as-is (design section 1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The reveal sets only the row box's scrollTop through pageListRevealTop, which wraps pageTabRevealTarget.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: page-tab-scroll.ts stays unchanged and the reveal never moves focus or scrolls outer panes (design sections 3-4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Add an isolated DOM test lane (test-dom with happy-dom, run in a child process).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The existing preload compiles TSX with solid-js/h on the server build, so it cannot test reactive interactions (design sections 1 and 8.2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Rows use For over a PageId string memo, and menus use For over key strings.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Focused nodes survive revision bumps (PGL-PLAN-001, verified-fixed).

supportedEdgeCases: A single page: Delete and Copy shapes are disabled.
First or last page: Move up or Move down is disabled.
Deleting a page with elements asks for confirmation; a cancel refocuses the row.
Read-only, including a switch while a menu or rename is open: editing affordances are hidden, and an open menu or rename closes.
Folded list: no rows render and the reveal does nothing.
A legacy stored preference without pagesListOpen, or a non-boolean value, loads as true.
Undo/redo and collaborator changes update rows through signals.rev().
Modifier keys and IME composition are ignored by the row keyboard handler.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real layout geometry of the reveal in DOM tests (happy-dom has no layout; it is helper-tested only).
Changes to the private sync Worker (no new Command kind is added).
intentionalTradeoffs: Reveal geometry is helper-tested only, because happy-dom does not compute layout.
Design plan pl-02 (preference) is merged into the wiring plan pgl-03, because the required field breaks App.tsx typecheck until App.tsx writes it.
residualRisks: The DOM harness feasibility under Bun 1.4.4 is proven only when pgl-02 runs.

acceptanceCriteria: page-list.ts exports pageListRows, pageListVisibleRows, pageListKeyAction and pageListRevealTop, and page-list.test.ts covers them against a real Editor.

PageList.tsx (exporting PageListProps) renders the details section, the listbox rows, the menu built from pageMenuItems with the vertical axis, a '+' button, read-only gating, and a scrollTop-only reveal.
PageList.test.tsx runs test-dom/page-list.dom.tsx in a child process. It requires exit 0 and 'ok <name>' for rows, highlight, click, keyboard, fold, read-only, rename and menu.
The root bunfig.toml, mise.toml, PageTabs.tsx and page-tab-scroll.ts are unchanged, and package.json changes only devDependencies.

Rows render with For over a pageIds string memo (the PageTabs.tsx:325 pattern) and menu items with For over key strings or Index. The keyboard, click and rename DOM scenarios assert that the same focused node survives a revision change: Enter on row 2 keeps the row-2 node focused and ArrowDown then focuses row 3, and the rename input survives an unrelated editor change and keeps focus.

The dependency install (a single `bun add --dev --exact` from the repo root) changes only package.json devDependencies, bun.lock and the declared node_modules artifact roots. tmp/pgl-s835/pgl-02-page-list/toolchain.json records the bun version, the install command, exit code 0, the resolved happy-dom version, and the before and after hashes of bun.lock and package.json.
